Definition: Anajah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Two men share this name in Nehemiah's day: one stands beside Ezra on the pulpit of wood as the law is read to the returned exiles, and the other sets his seal to the covenant the people make afterward. The name appears only in the work of rebuilding.
TheologicalSignificance: Two men with one name, both standing where the law was read and the covenant sealed, remind me that God's work is carried by ordinary men who simply show up and stand in their place.
